personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe spacing
personality_one_liner: A premium, high-contrast command center for outdoor movement that feels tactical, atmospheric, and distinctly non-generic.

spacing.rule: Generous luxury spacing rhythms combined with dense utility metric clusters. No cramped cards.

do's: Use heavily tinted dark glass over outdoor imagery for hero cards.
Bottom tab bar must have a frosted glass effect layered over content.
Use glass for the floating map action buttons in Explore.
dont's: Do not apply glass to metric cards or basic list rows.
Do not use light/white blur, only deep dark frosted glass.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Command center giving an immediate overview of today's potential and recent achievements.

states.loading: Dark skeleton pulses on hero and metric cards
states.empty: No recent activity: show a dramatic 'Start your first adventure' hero card.
states.error: Failed to load feed: simple text and subtle reload icon.

screens.layout: 1. Greeting (SpaceGrotesk xl). 2. Hero Recommendation Card (Full width, dramatic outdoor photo background, bottom gradient scrim, title, lime brandPrimary CTA pill). 3. Recent Activity Horizontal Scroll (Cards with route shape SVG, distance, duration). 4. Explore Teaser list.

screens.name: Move

states.error: Location error warning toast in Warning Amber.

screens.layout: Selector State: 4 large cards (2x2 grid) for Run, Walk, Cycle, Hike with subtle background photos and tinted overlays. Active State: Huge SpaceGrotesk metrics at top (Duration, Pace, Heart Rate), map/route preview in middle, large primary CTA (Pause/Finish) at bottom fixed above safe area.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Discovery surface for new trails and regions using atmospheric terrain visual abstractions.

states.empty: No routes in area: show illustration of empty trail and 'Search wider area' button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark map placeholder (or static dark topographic map image). Floating Action Button (FAB) for map layers. Bottom sheet anchored at 25% exposing 'Curated Routes'. When sheet expands, shows list of dramatic aerial trail photos with distance/elevation metadata.

screens.name: Stories
screens.purpose: Immersive visual feed of outdoor experiences, deeply tied to movement data.

states.empty: Illustration of campfire with 'Follow squads to see stories'.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll of edge-to-edge cards. Each card is an immersive outdoor photo with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). At bottom: Avatar, Username, Story Title, and a brandTertiary chip showing the activity stat (e.g., '14.2km Hike').

screens.name: Connect
screens.purpose: Community challenges and squad leaderboards without toxic generic social metrics.

states.empty: Illustration of hikers with 'Join a squad'.

screens.layout: Segmented control (Squads | Challenges). List of squads showing rank, avatar stack, and total squad distance. High contrast dividers. No generic 'likes' - focus on shared milestones and progression bars.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Identity and lifetime outdoor progression showcase.
screens.layout: Top cover banner (dark moody photo), overlapping Avatar. Name and bio. 'Lifetime Distance' hero metric. Grid of achievement badges (subtle surfaceTertiary circles with lime icons). Activity history list.

components.PrimaryButton: Pill shape (pill radius), brandPrimary (lime) background, onBrandPrimary text. No borders.
components.SecondaryButton: Pill shape, transparent background, borderStrong outline, white text.
components.MetricCard: surfaceSecondary background, md radius. Value in SpaceGrotesk (lg/xl), label in muted Geist (sm).
components.StoryCard: Full-bleed or lg radius card. Must implement the 3-stop vertical gradient scrim over the image. Text is always white (onSurfaceInverse).
components.Chip: surfaceTertiary or brandTertiary background. sm radius. Used for activity types or tags.
components.Avatar: Real photo. If initials, use surfaceTertiary with white text.

home_hero.alt: Mountain biker prepares for night ride at sunset with a headlamp

story_card_3.alt: Lone hiker with headlamp at night

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the 500 max font weight rule. SpaceGrotesk should be used at 500Medium for display and metrics, and Geist at 400Regular for body.

Implement the 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse >= 70%) on ALL image-backed cards (Stories, Hero, Explore routes) to guarantee text contrast. Ensure text is layered on top, not behind the gradient.
Maintain the layout strictness: No equal-sized card dashboards. Create intentional focal points with asymmetric layout components (e.g. 1 Hero + horizontal scroll).
Do NOT use @expo/vector-icons. Only use react-native-vector-icons with Phosphor icons or Feather if Phosphor is unavailable.
Do NOT use @expo-google-fonts. Load SpaceGrotesk and Geist via expo-font with local or remote assets.
Background should be near-black (#0A0A0A) and graphite (#1A1A1A/#242424) for surfaces. The electric lime (#C6FF3D) is the ONLY accent color, used sparingly for active states and primary CTAs.
In 'Move' active session, prioritize glanceability with huge typography for metrics.
For the 'Explore' tab map, use a static dark topographic map image or a dark-themed react-native-maps instance to act as the placeholder.
Do not use generic 'social' or 'fitness' concepts. Maintain the premium outdoor/adventure atmosphere through the curated imagery and restrained lime accent.
